assumptions.statement: The archive should still optimize for breadth and portability rather than exhaustive coverage.
assumptions.repair_if_false: Permit deeper branch-specific revisions in later releases.

assumptions.statement: Official or institutional sources remain sufficient for a compact anchor layer, even though later revisions may need more adversarial or specialist material.
assumptions.repair_if_false: Add sharper domain-specific sources without relaxing the archive’s compression standard.

assumptions.statement: A quarantine lane is necessary to keep the archive bold without laundering under-evidenced claims into canon.
assumptions.repair_if_false: Tighten promotion and demotion rules, not the archive’s ambition.

assumptions.statement: Observability deserves explicit treatment as a first-class branch rather than remaining implicit inside climate, land-use, and disaster notes.
assumptions.repair_if_false: Demote or merge note SS-008 if it proves redundant with verification or gatekeeping branches.

assumptions.statement: Proof surfaces deserve broader treatment than provenance alone; threshold credentials and derived-attribute checks are part of the same family of historically rising control surfaces.
assumptions.repair_if_false: Demote or merge SS-009 if wallet-mediated proof systems remain niche or fail to generalise beyond a few regulated sectors.

assumptions.statement: Object passports belong in the same proof-surfaces family as provenance, certification, and threshold credentials rather than requiring their own separate branch for now.
assumptions.repair_if_false: Split goods-governance into its own branch if passport regimes become a dominant portfolio cluster rather than one subtype of proof.

assumptions.statement: Transaction rails deserve explicit treatment as their own branch rather than being folded into proof surfaces or observability, because they change how compliant economic events are generated, not merely how they are later evidenced.
assumptions.repair_if_false: Merge SS-011 back into proof surfaces or gatekeeping if e-invoicing and real-time transaction reporting remain tax-local rather than cross-domain infrastructure.

assumptions.statement: Digitally controlled originals belong inside the proof-surfaces family for now; they look like the strongest current case where a proof surface becomes legally operative control rather than mere evidence.
assumptions.repair_if_false: Split title rails into their own mechanism family if additional notes accumulate or if the distinction from proof surfaces becomes too load-bearing to compress away.

assumptions.statement: Organisational authority credentials belong inside proof surfaces for now; they look like a strengthening of the archive's agency-and-eligibility story, not yet a separate mechanism family.
assumptions.repair_if_false: Split organisational authority into its own branch if wallet, mandate, payment, and filing systems converge enough to make machine-verifiable agency a dominant cluster rather than a proof-surface subtype.

assumptions.statement: Authoritative evidence exchange deserves explicit treatment as a query-surfaces branch rather than being folded into proof surfaces, because source-side retrieval changes the administrative unit of action from packet assembly to evidence orchestration.
assumptions.repair_if_false: Merge SS-014 back into proof surfaces if once-only systems remain narrow plumbing rather than a durable source of institutional leverage.

assumptions.statement: Relay surfaces deserve explicit treatment as their own branch rather than being folded into gatekeepers or transaction rails, because the decisive question is who is trusted to operate the connective tissue of exchange, not merely what may pass through it.
assumptions.repair_if_false: Merge SS-015 back into gatekeepers or transaction rails if certified relays remain a narrow implementation detail rather than a durable source of institutional leverage.

assumptions.statement: Status surfaces deserve explicit treatment as their own branch rather than being folded into proof, query, or relay surfaces, because runtime standing increasingly decides admissibility even when the proof, source, and carrier are otherwise valid.
assumptions.repair_if_false: Merge SS-016 back into proof, query, or relay surfaces if live standing checks remain a narrow implementation detail rather than a reusable cross-domain control surface.

assumptions.statement: Allocation surfaces deserve explicit treatment as their own branch rather than being folded into gatekeepers or scarce complements, because system-shaping demand increasingly changes not whether access exists but under which service class and burden-sharing terms access is granted.
assumptions.repair_if_false: Merge SS-017 back into the power or gatekeeping cluster if special large-load classes remain a temporary electricity-local reaction rather than a reusable governance shape.

assumptions.statement: Episode-specific adjudication loops such as electronic prior authorization do not yet require their own mechanism family; for now they are best treated as a strengthening of the archive's gatekeeper and transaction-rail grammar.
assumptions.repair_if_false: Split adjudication surfaces into their own branch if similar pre-decision loops accumulate across healthcare, permitting, customs, mobility, finance, or other domains.

assumptions.statement: Permit-ready models do not yet require their own mechanism family; for now they are best treated as a strengthening of the archive's gatekeeper and proof grammar in the built environment.
assumptions.repair_if_false: Split model-governed approvals into their own branch if similar machine-checkable permit objects accumulate across building, environmental, and infrastructure approvals.

assumptions.statement: Platform-enforced lodging-legality stacks do not yet require their own mechanism family; for now they are best treated as a strengthening of the archive's gatekeeper grammar in urban housing and tourism governance.
assumptions.repair_if_false: Split listing-permission rails into their own branch if registration-number governance, platform-side legality checks, and disablement powers spread broadly enough across occupancy markets to become a dominant recurring pattern.
